title: Two producers change at once while checkout starts showing the order summary

(2) In src/lib/db.ts, rename the OrderRecord property `customerEmail` to `email` everywhere in that file (interface and seed data). Do not touch other files.

In src/app/checkout/page.tsx, make CheckoutPage return `<order summary> | <payment status>` where the order summary is orderSummary('ord_1') from src/lib/orders.ts and the payment status is the payment's `status` field, e.g. `ana@example.com: pending | created`.
